title: Positive exponential sums cannot produce steepening followed by flattening along monotonic rolling
assumptions: Finite sum V=sum V_i exp(-lambda_i phi) has V_i>0 and constant slopes; phi is expressed in reduced-Planck units.
The history under consideration rolls monotonically toward increasing phi. Negative coefficients, direction changes and other potentials are excluded from this identity.
predictions: lambda is a convex slope average; d lambda/d phi=-Var_w(lambda_i)<=0.
A positive exponential sum cannot encounter lambda_early<lambda_mid then lambda_late along increasing phi; a separate localized feature or excluded dynamics is needed.
This is an algebraic obstruction in a restricted domain, not exclusion of all early/late unified cosmologies.
